tagline: Golf portfolio built for collegiate recruiters.
seoDescription: Recruiting portfolio for Samuel Masco, Evergreen High School golfer in the class of 2029. Explore stats, tournament results, academics, and contact information.

headline: Samuel Masco
subheadline: Golf portfolio built for collegiate recruiters.
bio: Emerging golfer with nine years of competitive experience, a 6.9 handicap, and relentless Colorado work ethic. I am ready to grow with a university that matches my drive on and off the course.

heading: About Samuel
subheading: Driven student-athlete focused on earning a competitive roster spot while preparing for a business-focused future in the golf industry.

children.text: My collegiate goals are to gain an excellent education that will prepare me for a business career in the golf industry while providing me with the opportunity to refine and grow my golf skills. I bring with me a character rooted in old-school Colorado work ethic, resilience, perseverance, and determination.

I understand that the road ahead is filled with triumphs, heartache, setbacks, growth, and patience mixed with countless hours of practice and tournament play. I am ready for both the challenge and the journey.

heading: Golf Resume
subheading: Tournament-tested competitor with a consistent training regimen and measurable results.

children.text: March - October: 5-6 days weekly, 1-6 hours per session. During high school season: 3 days with team, 2-3 days individually.
Focused on sharpening ball striking, course management, and competitive decision-making under pressure.

experienceList: Summit Cup Ryder Cup Event - Team Blue Invitee

heading: Academics
subheading: Balanced commitment in the classroom and on the course, pursuing rigorous coursework to prepare for a business career.

children.text: Business and related disciplines, including Accounting, Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Entrepreneurship, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems, and Real Estate.
